purpose: produce the first true v17 current-Control baseline, then test whether a candidate-only source-query skill can make symbol calls replace text-search rounds without leaking experiment content into production

experiment_boundary.subject: gpt-5.6-luna medium, standard service tier, read-only, multi-agent disabled
experiment_boundary.control: fresh clone of the complete currently installed AGENTS.md and skill/plugin environment
experiment_boundary.production_effect: none; repository and installed AGENTS.md, skills, srcq, deployment payload, and release state were unchanged

guidance: trigger on definition-location plus direct or cross-function relation tasks
locate an identifier once with bounded srcq rg
convert 1-based text coordinates to 0-based symbol coordinates
always pass an explicit matching language
make one depth-1 or depth-2 symbol calls query that replaces the next relation search
fall back without retry or widening when symbol is incomplete or fails

observed_symbol_behavior.csharp_run_1: three failed calls omitted explicit language and retried guessed coordinates
observed_symbol_behavior.csharp_run_2: source-query skill not read; no symbol call
observed_symbol_behavior.cpp_run_1: one failed call used a wrong relative path; language worked only because cpp is the tool default
observed_symbol_behavior.typescript_runs: source-query skill not read; no symbol call

no_model_probes.root_cause: srcq symbol calls defaults language to cpp; omitting language makes C# and TypeScript positions parse under the wrong grammar
corrected_results: C# ValidateUidsUnsafe succeeds with explicit csharp and exposes ordering plus the typed ValidateUid edge
C# ExecuteAsync depth 2 reaches SampleOnceAsync, sorting, validation, Read, and the configured node budget
C++ RayCastTest depth 2 reaches BvhTree::rayCast and rayCastInteral
TypeScript handleWebviewMessage succeeds with explicit typescript and exposes typed service calls
no_model_probes.inference: symbol relations can answer these relation chains, but the current model-facing coordinate and language contract is too error-prone for prose guidance alone

isolated_tool_probe_v1.boundary: external detached worktree and binary only; no repository, installed runtime, payload, Deploy, or Release change
isolated_tool_probe_v1.change: when --at is present and language was not explicitly supplied, infer a supported language from the source extension while preserving explicit-language priority and cpp fallback

three_language_equivalence.csharp: implicit language output exactly matched explicit csharp output
three_language_equivalence.typescript: implicit language output exactly matched explicit typescript output
three_language_equivalence.cpp: implicit language output exactly matched explicit cpp output
three_language_equivalence.explicit_wrong_language: remained authoritative and produced the existing semantic-unknown failure

counterfactual_replay.source: the three C# coordinates actually attempted by the rejected candidate
counterfactual_replay.conclusion: automatic language inference fixes the legal position but cannot repair guessed line or column values, so it is not sufficient for a six-run model experiment

isolated_tool_probe_v1.next_probe: test a name plus source-file hint that preserves automatic project scope and removes both language and column assembly from the model

isolated_tool_probe_v2.change: infer language for name queries from a consistent source-file extension supplied through existing root hints

three_language_result.typescript: unqualified name plus source-file hint succeeded and exactly matched explicit-language output
three_language_result.cpp: qualified name plus source-file hint succeeded and exactly matched explicit-language output
three_language_result.csharp: unqualified ExecuteAsync remained ambiguous across four definitions; a qualified name returned a useful partial tree but reached the time budget

isolated_tool_probe_v2.decision: do not run the full model experiment; the interface still requires language-specific qualification knowledge and does not provide one stable cross-language path
isolated_tool_probe_v2.next_probe: a 1-based definition-line query that uses AST evidence to select a unique callable definition without a guessed column

isolated_tool_probe_v3.candidate: resolve a unique callable definition from a copied 1-based source line
isolated_tool_probe_v3.reason: strict resolution requires AST outline initialization before the current target-resolution stage; reordering that path would affect existing position, name, scope, and engine-error contracts and was not a low-cost probe

isolated_tool_probe_v4.change: add --at-vimgrep so a 1-based PATH:LINE:COLUMN returned by srcq rg --vimgrep is mechanically converted to the existing zero-based position path; source extension infers language and explicit language remains authoritative
isolated_tool_probe_v4.targeted_tests: passed, including Windows drive paths, spaces, one-based conversion, zero rejection, option conflicts, and language inference

three_language_equivalence.csharp: bridge output exactly matched explicit csharp plus manually converted --at
three_language_equivalence.typescript: bridge output exactly matched explicit typescript plus manually converted --at
three_language_equivalence.cpp: bridge output exactly matched explicit cpp plus manually converted --at

isolated_tool_probe_v4.decision: sufficient for one formal model candidate because both observed language omission and coordinate assembly are removed without AST heuristics

formal_bridge_candidate.skill_treatment: trigger definition-location plus direct or cross-function relation tasks; use one bounded srcq rg --vimgrep result as one --at-vimgrep calls query; the symbol call must replace the next relation search and must not be retried

mechanism_observation.csharp: the bridge succeeded once but was followed by another relation text search, so it did not fully replace work
mechanism_observation.cpp: the bridge succeeded in both runs and no later relation search occurred, but the two runs expanded to 27 requests, 25 commands, and three unrelated failed commands
mechanism_observation.typescript: the skill and bridge were never used; the lower cost cannot be attributed to symbol

formal_bridge_candidate.ideal_cache_price: unavailable because cache-write accounting is inconsistent with later hits
formal_bridge_candidate.decision: reject; quality improved by two C# atoms but the actual observed price, requests, tokens, and time regressed overall, with a decisive C++ price counterexample

added_work: source-query skill reads, including one failed attempt at a nonexistent project-local path
project-file discovery and complete project manifest reads
larger source reads and an expansion into AABB implementation files
three unrelated failed commands and repeated file-list searches
cpp_command_chain_diagnosis.relation_mismatch: the candidate guidance hard-coded outgoing, which proves RayCastTest to rayCast to rayCastInteral but not the requested incoming direct call locations; completeness work therefore remained
cpp_command_chain_diagnosis.incoming_probe: one isolated incoming depth-1 call returned Camera_Script::selectLogic and Conductor::mouse_button_callback with exact source locations
cpp_command_chain_diagnosis.inference: incoming plus outgoing symbol evidence can cover the C++ relation requirements, but the current one-direction command needs two queries and neither query proves the project-manifest completeness boundary by itself

isolated_tool_probe_v5.candidate: one calls query with direction both
isolated_tool_probe_v5.reason: the current result, expansion, model renderer, machine schema, node budget, time budget, cut marker, and exit status all assume one direction; a correct combined query requires a dual-tree public contract rather than concatenating children or duplicating scans
isolated_tool_probe_v5.next_condition: design a shared-scope multi-relation result and budget contract before implementation; do not add another skill instruction that merely requests two independent calls

reasons: TypeScript regressed on both repetitions and aggregate required quality fell from 128/134 to 127/134
C++ price regressed in both repetitions and TypeScript price regressed in its second repetition
the target symbol mechanism never succeeded and the candidate violated its own explicit-language and no-retry constraints
aggregate observed price improvement therefore cannot be attributed to successful symbol use
decision.next_evidence_frontier: the position bridge is technically valid but does not control skill triggering or downstream search expansion; do not rerun either tested guidance. A future candidate must mechanically replace a complete relation-search/read round, especially in C++, before another six-run model experiment
